item: GuardedSession enters the connect-time SSRF guard
refs: PR pending; OPEN_QUEUE 2026-09-17 Two findings DISCLOSED (1); NET-01
summary: A guarded_session (Wikidata, OSM and dump downloads, ring_loader, gazetteer build, DuckDuckGo, AI installer) never entered ssrf_guard.connect_scope, so a name resolving to 127.0.0.1 was fetched and its body returned as 200 (reproduced on main 47e356835). GuardedSession.send now enters the scope for the first request and every redirect hop, with only the one proxy requests.utils.select_proxy picks for it (a loopback proxy allowed by exact address and port, no other environment proxy able to stand the guard down); the gethostbyname hooks now check their answers too (a socks4 destination). A refusal is ConnectTargetRefused (a RequestException, not a ConnectionError, so no retry-on-ConnectionError loop takes it for a transient failure); OO_SSRF_CONNECT_GUARD=0 stands it down. Refusal words no longer claim a pre-fetch check the session never made. The wiki adapter docstring that said the session lacked the guard is corrected.
